items.text: Etorikoki Yesu enetii Pilato
Ore pee ekenyu, netumo ilapolosak pooki o lpayiani lo lorere neiguanare pee ear Yesu metua.
Neen ninye nerik aaitarasaki olbalusui oji Pilato.
Enkeeya e Yesu
Ore Yudas ilo oitarasayie pee edol ajo eidipaki aaiguanare, neitoki ainosu neshuku nena pisai tomoni uni e nkosholai ashukoki ilapolosak kituaak o lpayiani,
ejo, “Aitarruoyie aitarasayie oltung'ani lemeeta entiyoto metari.” Kake etiaakita ninche, “Ainyoo natii ninche iyiook? Iyie ine.”
Nenang'aki nena pisai e nkosholai atua enkaji e Nkai neipung; nelo agor kewan.
Nedumu ilapolosak nena pisai enkosholai nejo, “Mebara ti nikipik olbene le Nkai amu osarge einosieki.”
Neiguana te nebo neinyiang'unye enkurma o laitobirani loo motioo pee enukarieki iltung'ana leeiking'a.
Enkaraki e ina pee eji ina kurma, enkurma o sarge o taata.

Ina kata eitabayioki ina natejo oloiboni le Nkai oji Yeremia pee ejo, “Neya ninche impisai tomoni uni e nkosholai nainosieki ilo otudung'oki enkinyiang'a, otudung'okito enkinyiang'a lkulikae ayiok le Israel.
Neishooyo aainosie enkurma o laitobirani loo motioo anaa enaaitanapa nanu Olaitoriani.”
Eikilikuanishore Pilato Yesu
Neitasheyieki Yesu te dukuya olbalusui neikilikuan olbalusui ninye ajoki, “Aa ira iyie olaiguanani loo Lyahudi?” Nejoki Yesu, “Iyie ojo.”
Ore pee eitang'or ilapolosak kituaak o lpayiani, neitu hoo ewaliki.
Nejoki Pilato, “Ai mining eneba imbaa nikinteenikini?”
Kake eitu ewaliki te mbae hoo nabo, o meing'asiayu olbalusui oleng.
Etudung'okoki Yesu enkiguana metaari metua
Naa ore apa ake to sirua le Pasaka, naa kelaaki olbalusui esiamo oltung'ani obo oena anaa oloyieu ninche.
Netii ina kata oltung'ani obo yioloti te nkarruisho oena oji Barabas.
Ore pee etumo, nejoki Pilato ninche, “Kalo iyieuu nalaaki intae? Ai Barabas anaa Yesu oji Kristo?”
Amu eyiolo ajo to lom eishooitie ninye.

Ore pee eton Pilato to lorika le nkiguana neirriwaki enkitok enye olkilikuai ajoki, “Toduaa miaas ae te ilo tung'ani lemeeta entiyoto amu atanyamala duoo too mbaa kumok te nkidetidet te nkaraki ninye.”
Kake etukurrakita ilapolosak kituaak o lpayiani lolorere metoomonu Barabas, neishooyo Yesu metaari.
Neitoki ake olbalusui ajoki ninche, “Kaing'ae te kulo pokira aare iyieuu nalaaki intae?” Nejo, “Barabas.”
Nejoki Pilato, “Kaa naa aitaas Yesu oji Kristo?” Nejoki pooki, “Inchooi metashei.”
Nejo, “Aainyo, kaa torroni etaasa ninye?” Neitoki aaitulusoo aabuak aajo, “Inchoo metashei.”
Enkig 21.6-9

Ore pee edol Pilato ajo meeta ae naidim ataasa, kake keponari ake oloilole nedumu enkare, neisuj inkaik te dukuya olorere nejo, “Maata taa nanu entiyoto to sarge lele tung'ani eng'urai maate ena bae.”
Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo, “Inchoo osarge lenye meeu shumata iyiook o nkera ang.”
Nelaaki te ina kata Barabas; neari Yesu too nkeenta, neishori metashei.
Nerik isikarini lo lbalusui Yesu atua enkaji o lbalusui naji Praitorio neiturrurrokinote oltim pooki.
Neoru nkilani enyena neishopoki olkila onyokie.
Neshetu olmarisian loo lkiku nepik elukunya enye, nepik entiyani enkaina enye e tatene, negilaki kung aakueniyie nejoki, “Supa olaiguanani loo Lyahudi!”
Nenotaki ninye neoru ina tiyani naibung'ita, neoshioshie endukuya enye.
Ore pee eidip aatakueniyie, neoru olkila onyokie neishopoki nkilani enyena, nerik ninye aapuo aashe.
Etashoki Yesu
Ore epuku aapuo neinepu oltung'ani le Kirene oji Simon nearaki ninye pee enap osalaba.
Ore pee ebaiki ewueji neji Golgata, aa keji ewueji e mborbor,
Olke 69.21
neisho ninche Yesu enaisho oo sabibu naitushulakaki olodua metooko. Ore pee eishamisham neany eok.
Olke 22.18
Ore pee eidip aatasho ninye, neor nkilani enyena aaoshie enkukuo.
Netoni ninche aarrip ninye te ine.
Nepik ele sirata shumata elukunya enye aajo “YESU ELE OLAIGUANANI LOO LYAHUDI.”
Neshei te ina kata te nebo ninye ilapurrok aare, obo te nkaina e tatene, o likae te nkaina e kedienye.
Olke 22.7
Nemor iloogiroo eipirripir ilukuny, aajo,
Yhn 2.19
“Eiyie doi ogil enkaji e Nkai nishet too nkolong'i uni, intajeu kewan; te naa iyie Enkerai e Nkai, tadou to salaba.”
Neiko sii ninche neijia lapolosak o lasirak te nebo lpaiyiani ejo,
“Kulikae ake eitajeu nemeidim aitejeu kewan, olaa ninye olaiguanani loo Siraeli. Inchoo taata edou to salaba pee kiruk ninye.”
Olke 22.8
Ore amu Enkai etipika osiligi lenye inchoo naa eitajeu taa Enkai ninye tenaa keetayie tipat; amu etejo naa, “Ara Enkerai e Nkai!”
Nemor sii lelo apurrok ootashoki te nebo o ninye.
Etua Yesu
Ore pee ebaiki saa ile, nerip enaimin enkop o metabaiki saa naaudo.
Olke 22.1
Ore pee ebaya saa naaudo, neishir Yesu to ltoilo sapuk ajo, “Eli, Eli, lama sabaktani?” Naa inchere, “Enkai ai, Enkai ai, aainyo pee kitung'uayie?”
Ore pee ening kulikae te lelo ooitashe te ine nejo, “Eliya eipoto.”
Olke 69.21
Nekuet nabo kata obo le lelo nepik osuguroi enaisho naisuijo oo sabibu neremoki eng'udi naado neisho metooko.
Nejoki ilkulikae, “Tapala maing'urai te naa kelotu Eliya aitajeu.”
Neitoki Yesu aishir to ltoilo sapuk, nedung'o tau.
Neiperra nabo kata olkarasha le nkaji e Nkai aaku are, aiteru te shumata o metabaiki abori, neikirikira enkop nedanya ndapidapo;
nebolo inkuraren neitopiuni seseni kumok loo sinyat ooirurate;
ore pee epuku too nkuraren eidipa Yesu atopiu, nejing ina ang sinyati neipang'aki ltung'ana kumok.
Ore ilo kitok loo sikarini oorripito Yesu o lelo ootii te nebo ninye, pee edol eikirikire enkop o kulie baa naatotiwuo, neureishoyu oleng ejo, “Esipa Enkerai e Nkai ele tung'ani.”
Netii ine wueji inkituaak kumok naaing'orita te nelakua naatusujutua Yesu eing'uaa Galilaya eisiaaita ninye.
Ore te nebo ninche etii Mariamu Magdalene o Mariamu ng'otonye Yakobo o Yosef, o ng'otonye layiok le Sebedayo.
Etunukayioki Yesu
Ore pee eaku teipa nelotu oltung'ani karsis oing'uaa Arimatea oji Yosef, otaa apa olointeng'eni le Yesu.
Nelo sii apa ninye enetii Pilato neomonu osesen le Yesu. Neitanapisho Pilato pee eishori.
Neitayu Yosef osesen, neirin te nkarasha sidai e kitani,
neirragie te nkurare enye ng'ejuk nataguetua to soit, neibeleleng'oki osoit sapuk enkutuk e ngumoto, nelo.
Netii ine Mariamu Magdalene o enkae Mariamu etoni aaipirare enkurare.
Ore taaisere aa enkolong nasujita ene Nkitobirare, neiturrurrokino lapolosak kituaak o Lfarisayo Pilato,
aajoki, “Lo kitok, kitadamutua aajo etejo, apa ilo kalamas eton eishu, ‘Ore pee elusoo nkolong'i uni, napiu.’
Intanapisho naa metorripi enkurare metabaiki enkolong e uni, pee mepuonu ilooiteng'eni lenyena aapurroo nejoki olorere, ‘Etopiwuo’; neaku elejare e siadi kitok alang ene dukuya.”
Nejoki Pilato, “Iatata larripok loo sikarini, enchom entorrip anaa enindimidimi.”
Nepuo aaitagol erripoto e nkurare, nepik olmishire osoit te nebo ilarripok.
